title: How to write a quote for an interior painting job
summary: Paste your painting notes into ChatGPT and get a clear interior painting quote. Check the rooms, the prep, and the price before you send it.

tests.prompt:
You help a painting contractor write an interior painting quote. Draft only. Do not send it.

Fill in these details. If a line is blank, write UNKNOWN and do not guess.

Customer name: [CUSTOMER NAME]
Job address: [JOB ADDRESS]
Rooms and surfaces: [ROOMS]
Prep work: [PREP]
Number of coats and paint: [PAINT]
What's included: [INCLUDED]
What's not included: [NOT INCLUDED]
Price: [PRICE]
Deposit: [DEPOSIT]
Start and finish window: [TIMELINE]
How long the quote is good: [QUOTE EXPIRATION]
Your name and business: [YOUR NAME]
Your phone: [YOUR PHONE]
Email or text: [CHANNEL]

Rules:
- Never invent details; if something is missing, ask or mark it UNKNOWN.
- Do not add rooms, ceilings, trim, or colors that are not in the details.
- Do not change the price or the deposit. Copy them exactly.
- Do not promise a brand or a sheen unless it is in [PAINT].
- Keep the tone plain and friendly. No pressure and no slang.

Output format:
Return these headings only:
Channel
Subject (NONE if this is a text)
Quote (180 words or fewer for email, 90 words or fewer for a text)
Rooms and prep
What's included
What's not included
Price and deposit
Next step
Facts used
Unknown

setup.agent: Paste this into ChatGPT, or into the chat assistant you already use.
steps: Write the customer name, address, each room and surface, the prep, coats and paint, what is included, what is not, the price, the deposit, and the schedule.
Add your name, phone, and whether this is an email or a text. Leave a line blank if you have not decided it yet.
Open ChatGPT, paste the ChatGPT prompt, and replace every [BRACKET]. Type UNKNOWN in empty brackets.
Check that every room on your note is in the quote, and that no extra room, ceiling, or color slipped in. Confirm the price and deposit.
Paste the quote into email or a text and send it yourself.
setup.approvalStep: You check the rooms, the prep, and the price against your walkthrough notes, then you send the quote yourself.
failureModes: The draft adds a ceiling, closet, or trim you did not include. Take those rooms out.
The price or deposit does not match your note. Put your numbers back in.
The draft names a paint brand or sheen you did not specify. Leave it general or add your real product.
Two floors or two houses get mixed. Quote one address at a time.

faq.q: The homeowner also asked about the ceilings. What should I do?
faq.a: If ceilings were not in your walkthrough price, keep them in What's not included and offer a separate figure later. Do not let the draft add ceilings at the same price.

faq.q: What if the customer is supplying the paint?
faq.a: Say that clearly in the paint line, as in the example. If they might run short, you can note that extra paint is on them, but only if you actually want that in the quote.

faq.q: Should I list every prep step?
faq.a: List the prep you will actually do. If you skip something, such as repairing large cracks, put that under What's not included so it does not become an argument later.

job: Paste room and price notes and get a clear interior painting quote.
who: Painting contractors who quote interior jobs and want a plain list of rooms, prep, and price a homeowner can accept.

example.scenario: A painter walked a house and is quoting the living room, hallway, and one bedroom, walls only.
example.input:
Customer name: Chris Nguyen
Job address: 40 Birch Road
Rooms and surfaces: Living room, hallway, and the front bedroom, walls only
Prep work: Fill nail holes, light sand, caulk gaps, cover floors
Number of coats and paint: Two coats, homeowner-supplied eggshell, color already chosen
What's included: Prep, two coats, furniture moving in those rooms, and a cleanup
What's not included: Ceilings, trim, doors, and the other bedrooms
Price: $1,850
Deposit: $500 to book
Start and finish window: Tuesday through Thursday next week
How long the quote is good: 21 days
Your name and business: Lee at Clear Coat Painting
Your phone: 555-0188
Email or text: email
example.output:
Channel: email
Subject: Painting quote for 40 Birch Road

Quote:
Hi Chris, this is Lee at Clear Coat Painting. Here is the quote to paint the living room, hallway, and front bedroom walls at 40 Birch Road.

Rooms and prep: Walls only in those three rooms. I will fill nail holes, do a light sand, caulk gaps, and cover the floors.

What's included: Prep, two coats of the eggshell paint you are supplying in the color you already chose, furniture moving in those rooms, and a cleanup.

What's not included: Ceilings, trim, doors, and the other bedrooms.

Price and deposit: The job is $1,850. A $500 deposit books Tuesday through Thursday next week. This quote is good for 21 days.

Next step: Reply or call 555-0188 if you would like to book.
Facts used: 40 Birch Road, three rooms, walls only, $1,850, $500.
Unknown: none.
example.notes: Made-up job details, only to show a room-by-room quote.
